title: Metrics are written only by an AIP's flow
quote: Metrics and the like should only ever be authored by an AIP's own flow.
means: Metrics, their measurements, lessons and every other doc are written only by an event of an AIP's lifecycle, never directly: a measurement by an AIP's Learn step, a lesson by the Learn step that drew it.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-40 that held
